title: Reduce reactions to accidental peanut exposure through oral immunotherapy

concept.text: Raise the reaction threshold in peanut-allergic patients through standardized oral desensitisation. This reduces risk during ongoing treatment but does not establish permanent, treatment-free tolerance. Proposed completion test: FDA approval for mitigation of reactions after accidental exposure, supported by a randomized phase 3 food-challenge trial demonstrating an increased proportion tolerating a 600 mg peanut-protein challenge after approximately one year of treatment. Test set by: FDA; the PALISADE/ARC003 programme used controlled oral challenge as a surrogate for mitigation of accidental-exposure reactions. Reported achieved: FDA approved Palforzia on 31 January 2020. Overlaps: CLM-01, IMM-04, PHA-04, DER-07. Sources given: [FDA Palforzia approval record](https://www.fda.gov/vaccines-blood-biologics/allergenics/palforzia) ; [FDA Palforzia regulatory assessment](https://www.fda.gov/media/135328/download).
